Title: Secret Black Hand... clarify *One card spoiler*

Messages.Author: adam....@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Just something I thought of that I wanted to make sure with the new
cards.

In the RPG, Black Hand could also be of different sects. Secret
Camarilla members for example.

In the card game, it was already determined that a Sabbat Black Hand
vampire can go anarch and retain its Black Hand status. You need to be
sabbat to go black hand, but not to maintain it.

Well saw some silly tricks with Cadet and certain vampires that have a
common ability, i.e. Advanced.

Cadet
Master. Triffle. Put this card on a Sabbat vampire in your
uncontrolled region who is not Black Hand. While this Sabbat vampire
is controlled, he or she is Black Hand. This card remains in play,
even the vampire is in the uncontrolled region. A minion can only have
one Cadet.

So its interesting that for some vamps as:
Valerius Maior, Hell`s Fool (ADV)
Dominique
Dominique (ADV)
Lambach

You can play Cadet on the uncontrolled sabbat vamp, and then when you
merge they become Non sabbat and still have black hand status. [Secret
training... dun dun dun...]

And my favorite...
Goratrix

That's right, merge and get a Camarilla Black Hand Vamp. Secret
training indeed...

I'm pretty sure this is correct. [I hope] LSJ?

Depends on card text.

With Blooding, for example, card text specifies that it only works while the
vampire is Sabbat.

Vampires printed with "Black Hand" in their card text, though, have (so far) had
no such condition -- they'd remain Black Hand regardless of their sect.

>

> training indeed...
>

No. Card text: "while this Sabbat vampire is controlled..."

When merged, the vampire is no longer "this Sabbat vampire" (since he's not
Sabbat), so the effect doesn't apply.

You can get Camarilla Black Hand vampires, though -- just take a vampire whose
card text has "Black Hand" and Clan Impersonate to change clans to a clan whose
default sect is Camarilla.
